gates.name: HIDE contracts real, not merely merged
gates.prior_standing: IN PROGRESS -- merged and green, but nothing has produced a real token yet
gates.controller_verdict: IN PROGRESS, and the controller has now identified WHY
gates.finding: The gate demands the live model turn loop produce real generated tokens through a live entry point. It cannot today, and the reason is not a HIDE defect. HIDE reaches its model over HTTP, and NO HTTP PATH CAN SERVE A .gravity ARTIFACT AT ALL.
evidence: crates/hawking-serve/ contains zero references to gravity (grep, whole crate)
the only executor of the artifact is an example: crates/hawking-core/examples/gravity_glm_tps.rs, entry GravityGlmGpu::open_dir
tools/eval/support_halo_gate.py print-baseline-command prints 'cargo run -p hawking -- serve --gravity <...>' as a prerequisite; that flag does not exist, so the printed command cannot run
gates.significance: This single missing wire is the common cause of G4 and G5. It is plumbing an existing engine into an existing HTTP server -- reachability, not speed. Speed belongs to the Codex lane; reachability does not, and was not blocked by it.
gates.campaign_action: lane L18 (gravity-serve) closes it. Queued at the head of wave 2.
gates.also_open: HIDE_KERNEL_TURN must be either promoted through its own gate or explicitly declared off-by-design with the consequence stated. It remains false. Its two documented prerequisites are the effectful-step approval resume and answer surfacing; whether they are now met is a question for L01.
